title: 百元美钞为何成洗钱最爱？全球每年2万亿黑金流动
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Talk to us about the scale of money laundering because you sometimes hear these statistics thrown out, like bigger than the entire GDP of Germany, certainly bigger than a lot of big tech companies and
segments.zh: 跟我们聊聊洗钱的规模吧，因为有时你会听到这些统计数字，比如比德国整个GDP还大，肯定比很多大型科技公司还大等等。

segments.en: things like that. How large are we talking about here? It's worth saying in advance that obviously no one really knows. The criminals are not filing accurate tax returns. So there's a lot of
segments.zh: 我们说的规模有多大？事先说明，显然没人真正知道。罪犯不会如实报税，所以这里有很多推测。

segments.en: supposition going on here. But the most widely used estimate is that we're talking about between two and five percent of global GDP. And since global GDP is approximately a hundred trillion
segments.zh: 但最广泛使用的估计是，我们说的是全球GDP的2%到5%。既然全球GDP大约是100万亿美元，

segments.en: dollars, that means, you know, between two and five trillion dollars being laundered globally.
segments.zh: 这意味着全球有2万亿到5万亿美元被洗白。

segments.en: And yeah, that's a pretty decent amount of money. You could build quite a lot of data centers with that. And that's growing all the time, you know, as we measure everything in data centers now.
segments.zh: 是的，那是一笔相当可观的钱。你可以用这些钱建很多数据中心。而且这个数字一直在增长，你知道，现在我们用数据中心来衡量一切。

segments.en: How many data centers can you build? Yeah, I mean, I don't know if the criminals are building a lot of data centers. I mean, they are choosing almost any avenue they can find to launder their money.
segments.zh: 你能建多少个数据中心？嗯，我不知道罪犯是否在建造很多数据中心。我的意思是，他们几乎会选择任何能找到的途径来洗钱。

segments.en: So perhaps that's the new new thing. But you know, the old things are still very much current. I mean, you were talking about obviously cash money earlier. And although we like to focus on shiny things
segments.zh: 所以也许那是新趋势。但你知道，旧方法仍然非常流行。我的意思是，你之前谈到了现金。虽然我们喜欢关注闪亮的东西，比如加密货币洗钱，

segments.en: crypto for laundering money. I mean, criminals are pretty traditional in a lot of the ways that they move their cash. So we are often talking about literal banknotes.
segments.zh: 但罪犯在转移现金方面往往相当传统。所以我们经常谈论的是实实在在的纸币。
